name: Poison Eve

features.name: Vine wilds
features.description: Always expand to cover their reel.

features.name: Flower Power
features.description: A hot zone on reel 5 opens a portal.

review:
An elegant 5x3 botanical game with expanding vine wilds that always cover their reel. When Poison Eve lands fully on reel 1, Liquid Magic turns every bottle symbol into her.

A bonus symbol in the hot zone on reel 5 triggers Flower Power, opening a portal on the leftmost reel. Medium volatility, 6,091x max. Gentle by Nolimit standards.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
